GetForumsWithPagination.Statement: SELECT w2_Forum.*, w2_Account.name FROM ( SELECT w2_Forum.forum_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( w2_Forum.forum_id, w2_Forum.date_created ) AS row_num FROM w2_Forum ) AS RowIndex INNER JOIN w2_Forum ON ( RowIndex.forum_id = w2_Forum.forum_id ) LEFT JOIN w2_Account ON ( w2_Forum.user_id = w2_Account.id ) WHERE @bgn_row_num <= RowIndex.row_num AND RowIndex.row_num <= @end_row_num ORDER BY RowIndex.row_num ASC
